title: Sensitivity analysis in real options studies: systematic review and recommendations
abstract: arXiv:2611.24266v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Real options (RO) modeling provides a powerful framework for valuing managerial flexibility under uncertainty in capital-intensive investments across various industries, including climate, energy, and transportation. However, the transparency and usefulness of such models depends heavily on sensitivity analysis (SA). This study reviews over 100 peer-reviewed RO journal articles to examine the extent and quality of SA practices. The review focuses particularly on the extent of model scrutiny: how many input variables are subjected to sensitivity analysis; whether local or global approaches are applied; and whether the shape of the input-output relationships is examined. Our findings reveal a strong overreliance on one-at-a-time (OAT) techniques and a corresponding minimal adoption of global sensitivity analysis (GSA). translated_title: 实物期权研究中的敏感性分析：系统综述与建议
translated_abstract: 实物期权（RO）建模为评估资本密集型投资中不确定性下的管理灵活性提供了一个强大的框架，广泛应用于气候、能源和交通等多个行业。然而，此类模型的透明度和实用性在很大程度上取决于敏感性分析（SA）。本研究综述了100多篇经同行评审的实物期权期刊文章，以考察敏感性分析实践的范围与质量。该综述特别关注模型审查的程度：有多少输入变量进行了敏感性分析；采用的是局部方法还是全局方法；以及是否检验了输入-输出关系的形状。我们的研究结果显示，学界严重依赖一次性改变单个变量（OAT）的技术，而全局敏感性分析（GSA）的采用却极少。这一方法论上的差距限制了实物期权领域批判性审视自身模型并支持其决策的能力。
tldr: 本文系统综述了100多篇实物期权研究文献，发现该领域严重依赖一次性单变量（OAT）敏感性分析而极少采用全局敏感性分析（GSA），并针对如何提升模型审查质量提出了改进建议。
en_tdlr: This systematic review of over 100 real options studies reveals a strong overreliance on one-at-a-time (OAT) sensitivity analysis with minimal adoption of global sensitivity analysis (GSA), and provides recommendations for improving model scrutiny practices.
